note: Fixed before any model run (decision-criteria.md). #1867: the four design cases of the evaluation plan (../EVAL_PLAN.md). The prompt is the #1804 generation prompt (1804-design-judgment/harness/gen-prompt.txt) unchanged for every case; the brief is BRIEF.md in the fixture (sha256 pinned in conditions.json). The prompt names no Skill and no file path other than BRIEF.md. Every case expects design-creation, which only S distributes: in B its reach, bodyRead and expectReads are false by construction and are not used (decision-criteria.md).
pathBase: Tool paths are resolved against the session cwd from the init event (the sample project root), normalised, and matched relative to that root; a path outside the root never matches.
reportNote: Reported per trial, never used for a level: which design-creation files were read (the Claude Code entry, the body, each reference), whether the asc body was read (the read trigger), whether the lp-new inquiries record and FONTS.md were read, and every file written. The Skill calls are in the row (skills). writesReport matches a few words in out/DESIGN-NOTES.md (仮説, 根拠/出典, ペルソナ/利用者の像) as a hint for the fresh context that counts the records (blind to the condition); it is not the gate (decision-criteria.md).

require.pattern: ペルソナ|利用者の像|利用者像

cases.prompt: このフォルダの BRIEF.md の依頼に対応してください。作業はこのフォルダの中だけで行ってください。終わったら、作成・変更したファイルの一覧を報告してください。

cases.why: #1804の既存のデザインシステム上の請求先の編集画面（業務の画面）。成果物はapp/billing.html（必要ならapp/billing.css）とout/DESIGN-NOTES.md。app/の既存のfileを変えたかはreport.writtenFilesで示す。

scoring.machine: Per S trial: design-creation body read (expectReads; also bodyRead), a reference read (referenceRead, report), the deliverable and the record written (writes.requireFiles; writeOk). Failures (no init or result event, a result error that is not the budget stop, the condition not received) are failures of the shared harness.
scoring.recordCount: The content of out/DESIGN-NOTES.md (the user picture with evidence and hypotheses told apart, the decisions tied to users) is counted after collect.mjs by a fresh context, blind to the condition (layers/gate-count.json), as decision-criteria.md says. It is not in runs.json.
